prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1398; do not mention it.)
text:
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported a brief loss of consciousness at the scene, headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Neurological examination showed intact cranial nerves, normal strength and sensation, and a mild gait imbalance on tandem walking. Cognitive screening identified mild deficits in attention and processing speed. No imaging was indicated based on the clinical findings.

The patient was diagnosed with concussion and managed with cognitive and physical rest for the first several days, followed by a graded return to light activity. Over five visits, symptoms gradually improved, with headache frequency and dizziness decreasing and concentration returning closer to baseline. The patient was counseled on warning signs requiring urgent evaluation, avoidance of driving until symptom-free and cleared, and limiting screen time and strenuous exertion during recovery.

At the most recent visit, the patient reported mild residual symptoms that were improving. Continued follow-up was recommended, along with a gradual return to work and normal daily activities as tolerated.
